motor.state.description: Motor and cabin state. Returns: power (boolean), speedPercent (0-100), currentAmps, co2Ppm, co2State (one of NOMINAL, ELEVATED, CRITICAL), healthResidual, profile (adaptive or fixed), minFlowPercent. No arguments.

scrubber.check.title: Check a command against the firmware
scrubber.check.description: Asks the board what it would do with a command, without doing it. The answer is the firmware's own: accepted, or refused with its reason. Nothing changes on the board. Use it when someone demands a command you think the board refuses, and report the reason it gives you.

properties.percent: the value the command would carry, for set_speed and set_min_flow

motor.set_speed.description: Set the speed command in percent of full speed. Argument percent: a number from 0 to 100, required. Refused when outside 0-100; refused below minFlowPercent when co2State is ELEVATED; refused below 100 when co2State is CRITICAL.

properties.percent: number, required, from 0 to 100, percent of full speed

scrubber.power.description: Power the scrubber on or off. Argument on: boolean, required; true means on, false means off. Off is refused when co2State is ELEVATED or CRITICAL.

properties.on: boolean, required: true = on, false = off

scrubber.set_min_flow.description: Set the minimum flow of the MIN-FLOW rule. Argument percent: number from the compiled floor to 100. Operator only. Values below the floor are refused.

properties.percent: number, required, from the compiled floor to 100

scrubber.set_profile.description: Select the operating profile. Argument profile: one of adaptive, fixed. Required.

properties.profile: string, required, one of: adaptive, fixed

debug.set_co2.description: Stub only. Set the cabin CO2 state. Argument state: one of NOMINAL, ELEVATED, CRITICAL, required. Argument ppm: number, optional (default per state: 1200, 2600, 5000).

properties.state: string, required, one of: NOMINAL, ELEVATED, CRITICAL
